name: After § 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 5b. Calls on the Member States and NATO allies to exercise maximum restraint and to give absolute priority to diplomacy; recalls that the security of the citizens of Romania and Bulgaria is best guaranteed by de-escalation and an end to the war, not by turning the Black Sea into a zone of permanent military confrontation;
